normalization_audit.explanation: Generator internal probability vectors (float64) are normalized with sum error <= 1e-9 (district: 6.66e-16, cluster: 2.22e-16). For diagnostic CSV logging, probabilities were rounded to 4 decimal places via round(float(p), 4). Summing 11 rounded floats yields maximum deviation up to 11 * 0.00005 = 0.00055 (5.00e-04). Initial validator parsed the 4-decimal serialized JSON column instead of evaluating internal float64 probabilities against the 1e-9 contract.
normalization_audit.post_serialization_rounding_diagnostic: PASS (within expected <= 1e-3 rounding bound for 4 decimals)

validator_audit.why_previous_pass_occurred: The initial validator output printed '-> PASS' unconditionally on stdout for max error lines, while gate_prob_d was evaluated against 1e-4 on 4-decimal rounded JSON values. This conflated serialized logging diagnostics with the internal 1e-9 normalization contract.
